id: \bTM08 contains Bulk Up. It raises Attack and Defense.
en: \bTM08 contains Bulk Up. It raises Attack and Defense.
it: \bLa MT08 contiene Granfisico. Aumenta Attacco e Difesa.
\rIl mio Pokémon è più carino del tuo.

id: \rI came here with my boyfriend, but I can't find him.
en: \rI came here with my boyfriend, but I can't find him.
it: \rSono venuta qui con il mio ragazzo, ma non riesco a trovarlo.

id: \bKids like you shouldn't be wandering around here in the dark.
en: \bKids like you shouldn't be wandering around here in the dark.
it: \bI ragazzini come te non dovrebbero andarsene in giro qui al buio.

id: \bYou're the first person I've seen down here.
en: \bYou're the first person I've seen down here.
it: \bSei la prima persona che vedo quaggiù.

id: \bI came all the way down here to show off to girls.
en: \bI came all the way down here to show off to girls.
